tool_input_args.value:
import json

data = json.loads(files)
entries = data.get("entries", [])

# Group by top-level skill directory
from collections import defaultdict
groups = defaultdict(list)

for e in entries:
    path = e["path"].replace("/workspace/", "")
    parts = path.split("/")
    if len(parts) >= 2:
        group_key = "/".join(parts[:2])  # e.g. "skills/state-customer-support"
    else:
        group_key = "(root)"
    groups[group_key].append({
        "relative_path": path,
        "name": e["name"],
        "is_dir": e["is_dir"],
        "size": e.get("size_bytes", 0)
    })

output_lines = [f"📁 Workspace Files — {len(entries)} total entries\n"]
for group in sorted(groups.keys()):
    items = groups[group]
    output_lines.append(f"📂 {group}/ ({len(items)} files)")
    for item in sorted(items, key=lambda x: x["relative_path"]):
        size_kb = item["size"] / 1024
        icon = "📁" if item["is_dir"] else "📄"
        output_lines.append(f"   {icon} {item['relative_path']}  ({size_kb:.1f} KB)")
    output_lines.append("")

summary = "\n".join(output_lines)
print(summary)
